rules.rationale: This is the empty-input base equation defining deleteAcc: with no remaining characters, the named accumulator summary is exactly ACC.
This is the iCons recurrence defining deleteAcc by a structural case split: it either skips the current character or appends it before recurring on the strict suffix XS.
This is the empty-input base equation defining reverseDeleteAcc: with no remaining characters, the named reverse-accumulator summary is exactly ACC.
This is the iCons recurrence defining reverseDeleteAcc by a structural case split: it either skips the current character or prepends it before recurring on the strict suffix XS.
